rows.name: Shield the line
rows.text: A party member's failed beat lands on you instead

rows.name: Hold fast
rows.text: Hold options one band better on a wall or in a doorway
rows.reads: fight: the walled place tag at a settlement with a wall

rows.name: Stand over
rows.text: A downed party member cannot lose their haul while you stand

rows.name: Braced kit
rows.text: Armour loses half the durability from failed beats
rows.reads: fight: body armour wear on a failed beat

rows.name: Rally
rows.text: Once per encounter, the whole party's next option is one band better

rows.name: Wall-captain
rows.text: Your won beats count double toward raid defence

rows.name: Unmoved
rows.text: You cannot be the second failure that downs a party

rows.name: Bulwark
rows.text: A settlement you are in treats its wall as one tier higher

rows.name: First strike
rows.text: Your first option in an encounter is one band better
rows.reads: fight: the opening tag on an encounter's first beat

rows.name: Read the ground
rows.text: Tracks stay readable for 12 ticks, not 6

rows.name: Turn the ambush
rows.text: An ambush on you gives you the first beat
rows.reads: fight: an ambush's opening beat is yours, one band better

rows.name: Quiet feet
rows.text: Cover counts 20 higher for you

rows.name: Mark prey
rows.text: Name one creature tag per day; one band better against it
rows.reads: the mark command; fight: the preyed tag against a creature holding it

rows.name: Ghost trail
rows.text: You leave no tracks
rows.reads: travel: entering a tile lays no track

rows.name: The long hunt
rows.text: A creature that fled can be followed to its tile

rows.name: Cull
rows.text: Your won beats remove 4 threat, not 2
rows.reads: world: threat a won beat removes

rows.name: Steady hand
rows.text: Appraisal ranges are half as wide

rows.name: Thrift
rows.text: Station fees are halved

rows.name: Third method
rows.text: Each process you practise gains one more method

rows.name: Salvager
rows.text: Failed combinations return 50%, not 30%
rows.reads: make: what a failed combination returns

rows.name: Maker's stamp
rows.text: Items you make gain xp 10% faster for anyone
rows.reads: make: stamps the item; growth reads the stamp

rows.name: Reforge
rows.text: Move up to 10 pts between two axes of an item, once

rows.name: Master's eye
rows.text: You see whether a recipe is registered before committing

rows.name: Signature
rows.text: One kind you discovered costs you no station fee, ever
rows.reads: make: station fees for the first kind you discovered

rows.name: Packer
rows.text: +10 load

rows.name: Road sense
rows.text: Ambush chance one band lower on road tiles
rows.reads: travel: route risk on road tiles

rows.name: Fresh news
rows.text: Prices from elsewhere are half as old for you

rows.name: Haggler
rows.text: Faction orders pay you 3% more

rows.name: Convoy
rows.text: A party following your route shares your ambush band

rows.name: Bonded
rows.text: Haul goals you take need half the collateral

rows.name: Factor
rows.text: Hold 40 open orders, not 20

rows.name: Caravan-master
rows.text: Mounts in your party need no upkeep on the road
rows.reads: mounts: your own mount's upkeep (a party's waits for MM8)

rows.name: Light fingers
rows.text: Lockpick options one band better

rows.name: Sure footing
rows.text: Hazard beats one band better

rows.name: Mapper
rows.text: Both ways down at a fork show their next beat's tags

rows.name: Pack light
rows.text: Leaving a dungeon never costs a turn

rows.name: Deep breath
rows.text: A second failure below floor 3 leaves you wounded, not down

rows.name: Key-maker
rows.text: Make a key for a dungeon you have reached the bottom of

rows.name: The way back
rows.text: Carry a downed character up without a beat per floor

rows.name: Hoard-sense
rows.text: The spoils pool of a floor is shown before you enter it

rows.name: Lingering
rows.text: States your exploits add last one beat longer

rows.name: Tinder
rows.text: Compile costs one component fewer, at least 2

rows.name: Second slot
rows.text: Carry a second deck

rows.name: Wide cast
rows.text: An exploit's state reaches one more creature
rows.waits: MM8 (more than one creature an encounter)

rows.name: Counter
rows.text: Remove one state tag from a creature or ally per encounter

rows.name: Storm-reader
rows.text: You see every system's path a full world day ahead

rows.name: Bind the weather
rows.text: Once a season, hold a weather tag on a tile for 3 world days

rows.name: Chain
rows.text: A state you add triggers its rule twice
rows.waits: MM8 (more than one creature an encounter)

rows.name: Fair hand
rows.text: Listing fees are 3% of the reward, not 5%

rows.name: Crier
rows.text: Goals you post are shown first on the board for a day

rows.name: Quartermaster
rows.text: Guild works you fund use 10% less stock
rows.reads: guilds: works switched on by you

rows.name: Surveyor
rows.text: You see a tile's generated fields before founding there

rows.name: Muster
rows.text: A pooled goal you post needs 1,500 coin pledged, not 2,000

rows.name: Even shares
rows.text: A pooled goal you post may pay everyone equally instead of by contribution

rows.name: Founder
rows.text: Charters cost your guild half
rows.reads: guilds: founding, by the officer who charters

rows.name: Steward
rows.text: A settlement you serve loses one fewer structure to a lost trouble
